name: Organic Sweet Fennel Seed Herbal Infusion Tea
whyItWorks: Crushed sweet fennel seeds (*Foeniculum vulgare*) contain volatile oils rich in anethole, fenchone, and estragole. These compounds relax the smooth muscle tissue of the intestinal wall, helping trapped gas dissipate gently without spasms.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Steep 1 tea bag in freshly boiled water for 10 minutes. Sip slowly after meals to release painful postprandial gas.
